mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_profile (,term_days,term_basis) VALUES (#{direction},#{partnerId},#{cutoffDay},#{cycleMonths},#{statementLagMonths},#{statementDay}, #{dueRule},#{creditDays},#{creditBasis},#{dueMonthOffset},#{dueDay},#{autoGenerate}, CASE WHEN #{direction}='AP' OR #{reconcileBasis}='INBOUND' THEN 'INBOUND' ELSE 'SIGNED' END, #{creditDays},'MONTH_END') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cutoff_day=VALUES(cutoff_day),cycle_months=VALUES(cycle_months), statement_lag_months=VALUES(statement_lag_months),statement_day=VALUES(statement_day), due_rule=VALUES(due_rule),credit_days=VALUES(credit_days),credit_basis=VALUES(credit_basis), due_month_offset=VALUES(due_month_offset),due_day=VALUES(due_day), auto_generate=VALUES(auto_generate),reconcile_basis=VALUES(reconcile_basis), term_days=VALUES(term_days),term_basis=VALUES(term_basis)
